item.title: Witchy Possum Holding Candle Avoidance Issues
item.description: A tiny possum in a witch hat clutches one lit candle and owns up to being a small witch with big avoidance issues. Perfect for introverts, baby witches and possum lovers, it makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Witchy Black Cat Brewing Chaos Mostly Tea
item.description: A cute black cat in a witch hat, sipping a steaming cup of tea and brewing chaos (mostly tea). A cozy, spooky-sweet gift for witchy tea lovers and cat people! By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Witchy Possum, Witchy but Mostly Just Tired
item.description: A sleepy little possum in a crooked witch hat, doing its best to be spooky but mostly just ready for a nap. Perfect for tired witches and possum lovers everywhere. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
